name: Sign in, acknowledge the risk warning, and read a lesson
description: Verifies the loss statistic is stated publicly before any account is required, and that the course opens after signing in and acknowledging.
steps: Confirm the opening screen states that 70-85% of retail CFD accounts lose money, before any sign-in
Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
In the left sidebar, click the module named "Contract Mechanics"
Click the lesson named "Pip Value and Tick Value"
expected: The lesson page shows the heading "Pip Value and Tick Value", body text, and at least one data table.

name: Answers stay hidden until the quiz is submitted
description: Verifies the quiz gives nothing away before submission and returns a marked paper with explanations after it.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
In the left sidebar, open the module named "Before You Start" and click "Quiz"
Confirm no option is marked correct or incorrect and no explanation is visible
Confirm the submit button is disabled while questions remain unanswered
Select one option for every question on the page
Click the button that submits the answers
expected: A score is shown as a percentage against the pass mark, every question is marked right or wrong, the correct option is highlighted on each question, and an explanation appears under each question.

name: A module answer key unlocks only after its own quiz
covers: answer key unlock after an attempt
description: Verifies the answer key is released module by module rather than all at once.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
In the sidebar, under Reference, click "Quiz Answers"
Confirm every module is listed as locked with no answers shown
In the sidebar, open the module named "Before You Start", click "Quiz", answer every question and submit
Go back to "Quiz Answers" under Reference
Expand the answers for the "Before You Start" quiz
expected: The "Before You Start" quiz is now unlocked and shows its correct answers with explanations, while the other modules are still locked and offer a link to their quiz instead.

name: Quiz results survive a reload
description: Verifies attempts are kept against the signed-in account rather than held in the page.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
In the left sidebar, open the module named "Before You Start" and click "Quiz"
Answer every question and submit
Refresh the page
expected: The quiz page opens on the saved result showing the score from the attempt, with buttons to review the marked paper and to take the quiz again.

name: Mark a lesson complete and keep it after reload
description: Verifies lesson completion is stored against the account rather than being a transient UI toggle.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
In the left sidebar, open the module named "Before You Start" and click the lesson "Is This For You?"
Click the "Mark complete" button
Refresh the page
expected: The button now reads "Completed" and the sidebar progress counter shows 1 completed item.

name: Search the course and open a result
description: Verifies search finds lesson content and opens the page it points to.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
Click the "Search" button in the top bar
Type "margin close-out" into the search box
Click the first search result
expected: A lesson page opens whose content discusses margin close-out, and the search overlay is no longer visible.

name: Position size calculator blocks an untradeable size
description: Verifies the calculator refuses to suggest raising risk to make a trade fit.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
Click "Calculator" in the left sidebar
Set "Account equity" to 100
Set "Risk %" to 0.5
Set "Entry price" to 1.0900 and "Stop price" to 1.0500
expected: A visible warning states the calculated size is below the minimum trade size and says not to raise the risk percentage to make the trade fit.

name: Navigate and read on a phone
description: Verifies the course is usable at phone width.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
Open the navigation menu using the menu button in the top bar
Click the module named "Risk Management"
Click the lesson named "Position Sizing"
expected: The "Position Sizing" lesson is readable at phone width with no horizontal page scrolling.

name: Take the Arabic quiz right-to-left
description: Verifies the quiz is a first-class Arabic surface, not an English component with translated labels.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
Click the language button in the top bar and choose "العربية"
In the sidebar, open the module named "قبل أن تبدأ" and click "اختبار"
Select an option for every question and submit
expected: The page reads right-to-left, the options are lettered with Arabic letters, the score and explanations are in Arabic, and the numbers are shown in Western digits.

name: Arabic calculator computes and warns right-to-left
description: Verifies the calculator works in the Arabic edition, including its warnings.
steps: Sign in with the account provider offered on the opening screen
Click the button that says "I understand" to acknowledge the risk warning
Click the language button in the top bar and choose "العربية"
In the sidebar, click "الحاسبة"
Set the account equity field to 100 and the risk percentage field to 0.5
Set the entry price to 1.0900 and the stop price to 1.0500
expected: The calculator labels and the warning text are in Arabic, the page reads right-to-left, the numeric results are shown in Western digits, and a visible Arabic warning says the calculated size is below the minimum trade size.
